title: Certify semantic absence for partial bootstrap projections
description: Complete clause-level, source-grounded absence proofs for the five bootstrap primitives that the corrected resolver marks evidence-underived: spellbook-copy-cost-and-asset-ledger, containment-portal-and-card-pool-instance-state, planar-return-and-declared-window-clocks, downtime-study-expense-and-training-ledger, and retained-inventory-property-xp-asset-creation. Anchor each to the specific source clause, search the clause-complete projection for equivalent or partial representation, and replace evidence-underived with a closure-grade result only when the negative proof is positive. Do not use proposed hook-name or sentinel absence as proof.
acceptance_criteria: Each affected row has a real source anchor, source presence evidence, a semantic projection query, and a positive absence result; partial representations remain fail-closed.
